1: Is surah ka aaghaz un alag alag huroof se hota hai jin ki wazahat Surah Al-Baqarah mein pehle guzar chuki hai. Yeh aayatein bahut bari shaan wali hain, aur yeh batata hai ke yeh Allah ki taraf se utari gayi hain. Yeh us Quran ki aayatein hain jo tauheed aur shariat khol kar bayan karta hai.
2: Qayamat ke din, jab un par baatein khul jayengi, to kafir yeh tamanna karenge ke kaash woh musalman hote. Un par wazeh ho jayega ke duniya mein un ka tareeqa kitna jhoota tha.
3: Aey Rasool, in jhutlane walon ko chhod dijiye ke woh jaanwaron ki tarah khayein aur duniya ke khatam ho jaane wale mazon se faida uthayein, aur un ki umeedein unhein iman aur neik aamaal se gaafil rakhein. Woh jald jaan lenge ke woh kis ghaate mein hain, jab woh Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne khade honge.
4: Jo bhi zaalim basti halak ki gayi, Allah us ka muqarrar waqt pehle hi jaanta tha. Halakat us ke waqt se na pehle aayi aur na baad mein.
5: Koi ummat apne muqarrar waqt se pehle halak nahin ki jayegi, aur jab us ka waqt aa jaye to us ki halakat taali nahin jayegi. Lihaza zaalimon ko yeh umeed nahin rakhni chahiye ke Allah un ka anjaam taal dega.
6: Makkah ke kafiron ne Rasool ﷺ se kaha: aey woh shaks jis par nasihat utari gayi, jaisa ke Rasool khud kehte the, tumhare daawe tumhein aisa dikhate hain jaise tum par kisi ka asar hai, aur tum aise logon ki tarah chalte ho jin par asar hota hai.
7: Tum farishton ko gawahi dene ke liye kyun nahin bula lete, ya hamare liye halakat kyun nahin maang lete, hamare kufr ki wajah se?
8: Un ke is khayal ke jawab mein ke farishte laaye jayein, Allah ne farmaya: Main farishte sirf us waqt bhejta hoon jab yeh hikmat ke mutabiq ho, yani jab tumhein saza dene ka waqt aa jaye. Aur agar farishte bhej diye jate aur woh phir bhi iman na laate, to un ka azaab foran aa jata.
9: Maine hi yeh Quran Muhammad ﷺ ke dil par utara hai, logon ke liye ek nasihat bana kar. Aur Main hi Quran ki hifazat karoonga, is se ke is mein koi cheez barhayi jaye ya ghatai jaye, ya is mein koi cheez badal di jaye ya tabdeel kar di jaye.
10: Aey Rasool, Maine aap se pehle bhi pichle kafir giroh ki taraf rasool bheje aur unhon ne unhein jhutlaya. Lihaza aap apni qaum ke jhutlane ke lihaz se koi anokhe rasool nahin.
11: Aur pichle kafir giroh ke paas koi rasool nahin aaya magar yeh ke unhon ne use jhutlaya aur us ka mazaaq udaya.
12: Aur jis tarah Maine un ummaton ke dilon mein jhutlana chhod diya, usi tarah Main Makkah ke mushrikon ke dilon mein bhi use chhod doonga, un ki mukhalifat aur un ki hath-dharmi ki wajah se.
13: Woh is Quran par iman nahin laate jo Muhammad ﷺ par utara gaya. Aur apne rasoolon ko jhutlane walon ko halak karne ka Allah ka dastoor pehle bhi guzar chuka hai, lihaza jhutlane walon ko us par gaur karna chahiye.
14: Aur yeh jhutlane wale apni hath-dharmi par jame rahenge chahe khuli dalilon se un par haqq saaf ho jaye, aur chahe Main un ke liye aasman ka koi darwaza khol doon aur woh us mein lagatar chadhte rahein.
15: To bhi woh iman na laate, aur kehte: hamari aankhein ab nahin dekh sakteen, aur jo hum ne dekha woh jaadu ka asar tha, lihaza hum par jaadu kar diya gaya hai.
16: Aur Hum ne aasmaano mein bade sitare rakhe taake log sahra aur samundar ke andhere mein apne safar mein un se raasta paayein. Aur Hum ne unhein un logon ke liye bhi banaya jo un par gaur karte hain, taake woh Allah ki qudrat samajh lein, paak hai Woh.
17: Aur Hum ne aasmaano ko har us shaytan se mehfooz kiya jo Allah ki rehmat se nikaal diya gaya.
18: Siwaye us ke jo chhup kar oopar ki baatein sunne ki koshish kare, to use ek jalta hua shola aa lagega aur woh jal jayega.
19: Aur Maine zameen ko bichhaya taake log us par basein, aur Hum ne us par mazboot pahaad rakhe taake woh logon ko dagmagane na de, aur Maine us mein tarah tarah ki fasalein ugaayin.
20: Aur aey logo, Maine tumhare liye zameen par woh khane aur peene ki cheezein rakhin jo tumhein sahara dein jab tak tum duniya ki zindagi mein ho.
21: Aur har woh cheez jo logon aur jaanwaron ko faida deti hai, Main use paida karne aur us se logon ko faida pahunchane par qaadir hoon. Aur Main aisi cheezein sirf us muqarrar miqdaar mein deta hoon jo Meri hikmat aur Meri marzi tai karti hai.
22: Aur Maine hawaein bheji jo baadal ko baar-dar karti hain, aur Maine un baar-dar baadalon se baarish barsayi aur tumhein baarish ke paani se sairaab kiya. Aey logo, tum zameen par chashmon aur kuon mein is paani ko jama karke rakhne wale nahin, balke Allah hi hai jo us paani ko un mein rokta hai.
23: Aur Main hi murdon ko zinda karta hoon: unhein adam se paida karke aur maut ke baad dobara uthaa kar. Aur Main hi zindon ko maut deta hoon jab un ka waqt aa jata hai. Aur Main hi hoon jo baaqi rahunga aur zameen ka aur jo kuch us par hai us ka waris banunga.
24: Aur Main un ko bhi jaanta hoon jo tum se pehle paida hue aur mar gaye, aur un ko bhi jo tumhare baad paida honge aur marenge. Is mein se kuch Mujh se chhipa nahin.
25: Aur aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb un sab ko Qayamat ke din jama karega taake neki karne wale ko us ki neki ka badla de aur burai karne wale ko us ke gunahon ka. Woh apne intezam mein Hikmat wala aur Jaanne wala hai. Us se kuch chhipa nahin.
26: Aur Maine Adam (alaihis salaam) ko sookhi hui mitti se banaya, jo maarne par bajti hai. Aur yeh mitti, jis se woh banaye gaye, kaali thi aur apni lambi muddat ki wajah se us ki boo badal chuki thi.
27: Aur Maine jinnon ke baap ko Adam (alaihis salaam) ke paida karne se pehle jhulsa dene wali aag se banaya.
28: Aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Allah ne farishton se aur Iblis se, jo un ke saath tha, farmaya: Main ek aisi makhlooq banane wala hoon jo sookhi hui mitti se hogi jo maarne par bajti hai, jo kaali hai aur jis ki boo badal chuki hai.
29: Phir jab Main us ki shakl poori kar loon aur us ki takhleeq mukammal kar doon, to Mere hukm ki taabedaari mein aur us ki izzat ke liye use sajda karna.
30: Chunanche farishton ne hukm maana aur sab ne sajda kiya jaisa un ke Rubb ne unhein hukm diya.
31: Magar Iblis ne, jo farishton ke saath tha magar un mein se nahin tha, farishton ke saath Adam (alaihis salaam) ko sajda karne se inkaar kar diya.
32: Jab Iblis ne Adam (alaihis salaam) ko sajda karne se inkaar kiya, to Allah ne us se farmaya: tujhe kis cheez ne roka aur kis ne tujhe un farishton ke saath sajda karne se baaz rakha jinhon ne Mere hukm ki taabedaari mein sajda kiya?
33: Iblis ne gurur ke saath kaha: mere liye yeh zaib nahin deta ke main us makhlooq ko sajda karoon jise tu ne sookhi hui mitti se banaya, jo pehle kaali, lassdar mitti thi.
34: Allah ne Iblis se farmaya: Jannat se nikal ja, kyunke tu nikaala hua hai.
35: Aur tujh par Meri laanat hai aur tu Meri rehmat se Qayamat ke din tak nikaala hua hai.
36: Iblis ne kaha: aey Rubb, mujhe zinda rehne de aur mujhe maut na de us din tak jab Adam (alaihis salaam) aur un ki aulaad dobara zinda kiye jayenge.
37: Allah Buland ne farmaya: tu un logon mein se hai jinhein Main lambi umar doonga.
38: Us waqt tak jab tamam makhlooq mar jayegi, soor ki pehli phoonk par.
39: Iblis ne kaha: aey Rubb, kyunke tu ne mujhe gumraah kiya, is liye main zameen par un ke liye gunah khoobsurat bana doonga, aur main un sab ko seedhe raaste se bhatka doonga.
40: Siwaye un bandon ke jinhein tu chun le ke woh tere liye khaalis ibadat karne wale hon.
41: Allah ne farmaya: yeh seedha raasta hai jo Mujh tak pahunchta hai.
42: Mere khaalis bandon ko bahkane par tera koi zor aur koi ikhtiyar nahin, siwaye un ke jo tere peeche chalein aur gumraah ho jayein.
43: Aur Jahannam Iblis ka aur un tamam logon ka waada kiya hua thikana hai jo us ke peeche chale aur gumraah hue.
44: Jahannam ke saat darwaze hain jin se woh daakhil honge. Aur us ke har darwaze ke liye Iblis ke pairokaaron mein se ek muqarrar tadaad hai jo us se daakhil hogi.
45: Aur jo log Allah se darte rahe, Us ke hukm par chal kar aur nafarmani se bach kar, un ke liye baagh aur chashme honge.
46: Jab woh daakhil honge to un se kaha jayega: har museebat se aman aur har dar se hifazat ke saath is mein daakhil ho jao.
47: Aur Maine un ke seenon se woh dushmani aur woh hasad nikaal diya jo un mein tha. Woh bhai bhai honge, ek doosre se mohabbat karne wale, takhton par bethe hue aur ek doosre ki taraf dekhte hue.
48: Unhein wahan koi thakaan nahin pahunchegi, aur unhein wahan se nikaala nahin jayega. Balke woh us mein hamesha rahenge.
49: Aey Rasool, Mere bandon ko bata dijiye ke Main un mein se jo tauba kare us ke liye Bakhshne wala hoon, aur un par Meharban hoon.
50: Aur unhein yeh bhi bata dijiye ke Mera azaab sakht azaab hai, lihaza unhein Meri taraf tauba karni chahiye taake unhein Meri magfirat mile aur woh Mere azaab se mehfooz rahein.
51: Aur unhein Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ke un mehmanon ka qissa bhi suna dijiye jo farishte the aur jo unhein ek bete ki khush-khabri dene aaye the, aur Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ki halakat ki khabar le kar.
52: Jab woh un ke paas aaye aur unhon ne kaha 'salaam', to unhon ne un ke salaam ka us se behtar jawab diya aur un ke saamne khane ke liye ek bhuna hua bachhda rakh diya, kyunke unhein khayal tha ke woh insaan hain. Phir jab unhon ne us mein se na khaya, to unhon ne kaha: hum tum se darte hain.
53: Farishton mein se bheje huon ne kaha: dariye nahin! Hum aap ko ek aisi baat batane aaye hain jo aap ko khush kar degi. Aap ke haan bada ilm wala beta hone wala hai.
54: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne, bete ki is khush-khabri par hairan ho kar, un se kaha: kya tum mujhe yeh khush-khabri de rahe ho jab ke mujhe boorhapa aa pahuncha hai? Yeh tum mujhe kaisi khush-khabri de rahe ho?
55: Farishton mein se bheje huon ne Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) se kaha: hum aap ko us haqq ki khush-khabri de rahe hain jis mein koi shak nahin, lihaza aap un logon mein se na hon jo hamari di hui khush-khabri se mayoos ho jayein.
56: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: apne Rubb ki rehmat se un ke siwa kaun mayoos hota hai jo Allah ke seedhe raaste se bhatak gaye hon?
57: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: aey bheje huo, phir woh kaun sa maamla hai jo tumhein Allah ki taraf se laaya hai?
58: Farishton mein se bheje huon ne kaha: Allah ne humein ek aisi qaum ko halak karne bheja hai jo bade fasaad aur bade bure kaamon ki mujrim hai, yani Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum.
59: Siwaye Lut (alaihis salaam) ke ghar walon aur un mominon ke jo un ki pairvi karte hain, kyunke woh is halakat mein shaamil nahin honge aur Hum un sab ko us se bacha lenge.
60: Siwaye un ki biwi ke, kyunke Hum ne tai kar diya hai ke woh un logon mein se hogi jo peeche reh jayenge aur halakat mein shaamil honge.
61: Phir jab farishton mein se bheje hue Lut (alaihis salaam) ke ghar walon ke paas mardon ki shakl mein aaye,
62: To Lut (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: main tumhein nahin pehchanta, aur na jaanta hoon ke tum kaun ho.
63: Farishton mein se bheje huon ne Lut (alaihis salaam) se kaha: dariye nahin! Aey Lut, hum aap ke paas woh halak karne wala azaab le kar aaye hain jis ke baare mein aap ki qaum shak karti hai.
64: Aur hum aap ke paas haqq le kar aaye hain jis mein koi mazaaq nahin, aur jo khabar hum aap ko dete hain us mein hum sachche hain.
65: Lihaza raat ka kuch hissa guzarne ke baad apne ghar walon ko le kar nikal jaiye. Un ke peeche peeche chaliye aur tum mein se koi peeche mud kar na dekhe ke un par kya guzri. Aur wahan chale jaiye jahan Allah ne aap ko jaane ka hukm diya hai.
66: Aur Hum ne Lut (alaihis salaam) ko wahi ke zariye woh maamla bata diya jo Hum ne tai kar rakha tha, yani yeh ke subah hote hi woh log aakhiri shaks tak mita diye jayenge.
67: Aur Sadoom ke log Lut (alaihis salaam) ke mehmanon par khushi manate hue aaye, is chaahat ke saath ke be-haayi ka kaam karein.
68: Lut (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: yeh log mere mehman hain, lihaza jo tum un ke saath karna chahte ho us se mujhe ruswa na karo.
69: Aur Allah se daro: yeh be-haayi ka chalan chhod do aur apne is bure kaam se mujhe zaleel na karo.
70: Un ki qaum ne un se kaha: kya hum ne tumhein kisi ko mehman banane se mana nahin kiya tha? Aur jo pehle se khabardar kar de, us ne is baat ka uzr poora kar diya ke woh baad mein mawakhiza karega.
71: Lut (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: yeh meri qaum ki auratein hain, jo mere liye betiyon ki tarah hain. In se nikah kar lo agar tum apni khwahish poori karna chahte ho.
72: Aey Rasool, aap ki umar ki qasam, Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum apni shahwaton ke peeche andhi ho kar bhatak rahi thi.
73: Phir sooraj nikalte waqt unhein halak karne wale azaab ne aa pakda.
74: Aur Hum ne un ki bastiyan ulta deen aur un par pakki hui mitti ke paththaron ki baarish barsayi.
75: Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum par utarne wale azaab ke is waqiye mein un logon ke liye nishaniyan hain jo gaur karte hain.
76: Aur Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ki bastiyan ek maujood raaste par hain aur guzarne wale musafiron ko nazar aati hain.
77: Jo kuch hua us mein mominon ke liye ek nishani hai jis se woh sabaq lein.
78: Aur Shoaib ki qaum, jo ek aisi basti mein rehti thi jise ghane darakhton ne gher rakha tha, zaalim thi: us ne Allah ka inkaar kiya aur Us ke rasool Shoaib (alaihis salaam) ko jhutlaya.
79: Chunanche Hum ne un se badla liya jab azaab ne unhein aa pakda. Aur Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ki bastiyan aur Shoaib ki qaum ke thikane ek aise raaste par hain jo guzarne walon ke saamne khula hai.
80: Aur be-shak Samood ne, jo Hijr wale the, yani Hijaz aur Shaam ke darmiyan ek jagah ke, apne nabi Saleh (alaihis salaam) ko jhutla kar haqeeqat mein tamam rasoolon ko jhutla diya.
81: Aur Hum ne unhein aise suboot aur aisi nishaniyan deen jo un ki us baat ki sachhaai batati theen jo woh apne Rubb ki taraf se laaye. In mein se ek woh ountni thi. Magar unhon ne in nishaniyon se koi sabaq na liya aur un par koi dhyaan na diya.
82: Aur woh pahaadon ki chattanon ko taraash kar un mein ghar banate the jin mein woh us cheez se mehfooz rehte the jis se woh darte the.
83: Phir subah ke waqt unhein azaab ki ek kadak ne aa pakda.
84: Aur jo maal aur jo ghar unhon ne kamaye the woh Allah ke azaab ko na hata sake.
85: Aur Hum ne aasmaano aur zameen ko aur jo kuch un ke darmiyan hai use be-kaar aur bina kisi hikmat ke nahin banaya. Hum ne yeh sab ek sachche maqsad ke saath hi banaya. Aur Qayamat zaroor aayegi, lihaza aey Rasool, un logon se munh pher lijiye jo aap ko jhutlate hain, aur unhein khoobsurti ke saath maaf kar dijiye.
86: Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb hi har cheez ka Khaaliq aur har cheez ka Jaanne wala hai.
87: Aur Hum ne aap ko Surah Al-Fatihah di hai, jo saat aayaton par mushtamil hai, aur Hum ne aap ko Quran-e-Azeem bhi diya hai.
88: Aur un waqti mazon ki taraf apni nigah na barhaiye jo Hum ne kafiron ke kuch tabaqon ko diye hain, aur un ke jhutlane par gam na kijiye. Aur mominon ke saath narmi se pesh aaiye.
89: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: main to be-shak azaab se daraane wala hoon aur woh baat khol kar bayan karta hoon jo tumhein hidayat degi.
90: Main tumhein us azaab jaise azaab se daraata hoon jo Allah ne un logon par utara jinhon ne rasoolon ko jhutlane ke liye ek doosre ka saath diya.
91: Jo Quran ke kuch hisson ko to maante hain aur baaqi hisson ko jaadu, kahanat ya sheri kehte hain.
92: Aey Rasool, aap ke Rubb ki qasam, Main Qayamat ke din un sab ka hisaab loonga jo use tukde tukde karte hain,
93: Hum un se un kufr aur un gunahon ke baare mein poochenge jo unhon ne duniya mein kiye.
94: Lihaza aey Rasool, Allah ki taraf us daawat ka khula elaan kijiye jis ka Us ne aap ko hukm diya, aur is par koi dhyaan na dijiye jo mushrik kehte aur karte hain.
95: Aur un se dariye nahin, kyunke hum aap ke liye Quraysh ke un kufr ke sardaron ke muqable mein kaafi hain jo aap ka mazaaq udate hain,
96: Woh log jo Allah ke saath koi aur maabood banate hain. Woh jald jaan lenge ke Allah ke saath sharik thehrane ka anjaam kitna bura hai.
97: Aur Hum jaante hain ke aap ka dil, aey Rasool, un ke jhutlane aur un ke mazaaq se tang hota hai.
98: Lihaza Allah ki taraf rujoo kijiye: Us ki paaki bayan kijiye ke Woh har us cheez se buland hai jo Us ke laayak nahin, aur Us ke kamaal ki sifaat ke saath Us ki taarif kijiye; aur un logon mein se ho jaiye jo Allah ki ibadat karte hain aur Us se dua karte hain. Isi mein aap ke dil ki tangi ka ilaaj hai.
99: Aur apne Rubb ki ibadat karte rahiye aur usi par jame rahiye jab tak aap zinda hain, yahan tak ke isi haal mein aap ko maut aa jaye.
